description: Search the verbatim record of speeches in the National Council and Council of States (Amtliches Bulletin transcripts) by speaker and/or keyword, optionally within a date range or session. Returns speaker, function, parliamentary group, canton, council, date, the business debated (short number + title when resolvable), a plain-text excerpt centred on the keyword, and a link to the official Bulletin debate. Keyword matching is case-sensitive and matches the speech's original language (e.g. 'Klimaschutz', 'Neutralität', 'intelligence artificielle'). Examples: {speaker:'Noser', keyword:'Datenschutz'}; {keyword:'Kita', date_from:'2024-01-01'}; {person_number:4057}. Speaker names come from search_council_members.

excerpt_chars.description: Max characters of speech text per result

keyword.description: Case-sensitive word/phrase in the speech text, in the language it was spoken, e.g. 'Klimaschutz'

language.description: Language of labels such as council name (speech text stays in its original language)

person_number.description: Exact PersonNumber of a council member (from search_council_members ID)

speaker.description: Fragment of the speaker's full name, e.g. 'Noser', 'Funiciello'

name: search_parliament_speeches
title: Search parliamentary speeches (Amtliches Bulletin)
